description: The amount of text, measured in tokens, that a model reads in one request: the prompt, any retrieved passages and the answer so far.
A list of numbers that represents the meaning of a text, so that similar texts lie close together. Used for **semantic search**.
Answering only from supplied sources and pointing to them, instead of from what the model happens to remember.
A repeatable test of a model-based system: fixed inputs, an expected behaviour and a pass threshold.
